title: custody.moved body
description: Tells a former holder that its task moved, or a later claimant that another claim was recorded first; later results are kept as late work.

custody_token.description: The custody token the receiver held or claimed under; a later claimant gets the token of the claim recorded first.

sequence.description: The next number in the task's numbering of confirmations and moves (custody.confirmed's sequence): the receiver applies no confirmation numbered below it.

reason.description: reassigned: custody.decide moved it; adopted_elsewhere: another holder took it over; cancelled: the request stopped; claimed_elsewhere: another claim for the task was recorded first; withdrawn: the team services withdrew the task from its queue after this host pulled it. In both, the receiver stops and sends no result (README, "Custody windows").
